title: Rental Vehicle Coordination Tariff Rule: Weekly Maximum of Young-Renter Fee Days
content:
**Tariff rule.** The fee days of the young-renter charge on a Rental Vehicle Coordination rental, being the rental days on which the young-renter fee is levied, follow a weekly maximum: a rental of seven or more rental days carries 5 fee days for each full seven-day block plus its remaining rental days up to 5; a rental of at least the weekly-rate threshold of 5 rental days (the same 5 days in every class) but fewer than seven rental days carries its rental days up to 5; a shorter rental carries every rental day.

Rental days are the whole days between the pickup date and the return date, plus one where the return time as counted is later than the pickup time of day. The remaining rental days are those left once every full seven-day block is taken out.

## Fee days by length of rental

| Rental days | Fee days |
|---|---|
| 1 to 4 | Every rental day |
| 5 or 6 | The rental days, up to 5, so 5 |
| 7 | 5 (one full block, no remaining day) |
| 8 to 11 | 5 for the full block plus the 1 to 4 remaining days |
| 12 or 13 | 5 for the full block plus 5 (the 5 or 6 remaining days held at 5), so 10 |
| 14 | 10 (two full blocks) |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

- 4 rental days carry 4 fee days; 5 rental days carry 5; 6 rental days still carry 5.
- 11 rental days carry 9 fee days; 12 rental days carry 10.
- 15 rental days carry 10 for two full blocks plus 1 remaining day, so 11 fee days.
